Sample.evidence_source: Twenty-one interviews were conducted with members of the Cowichan Tribes to understand reasons for suicide in one community.

Country.evidence_source: Its aims are to understand the meanings of suicide for members of the Cowichan Tribes, a Canadian First Nation, and to find explanations for suicidal behavior among tribal members.

Type.evidence_source: Twenty-one interviews were conducted with members of the Cowichan Tribes to understand reasons for suicide in one community.

Area.evidence_source: Qualitative analysis identified explanatory constructs proposed by the interpersonal theory as well as negative conditions stemming from colonialism, as proposed by settler colonial theory. These results argue that Indigenous suicidal behavior is best understood from an interdependent standpoint.
